narrative:
Inventory optimization analysis for material PL1__MF18597A reveals an ERRATIC demand pattern 
with CV=0.220 and VARIABLE lead times (CV=0.422). The analysis recommends transitioning 
from the current SAP policy (no safety stock, MOQ=675) to an optimized (r,Q) continuous review policy 
with safety stock=3917 units and order quantity=8684 units. 

The optimized policy achieves 95% service level protection while reducing total annual costs by 
$43,295.07 (77.6%), primarily through better order quantity optimization. 
Mean demand is 1912.91 units/day with mean lead time 2.82 days. 
The reorder point is set at 9305 units to cover lead time demand plus safety buffer.

Recommended safety lead time is 2.05 days vs current SAP value of 3.0 
days, suggesting a moderate decrease. Lead time variability is driven primarily by transport factors (50% of variance).
warnings: Variable lead times (CV=0.422) increase supply chain risk

research_insights.selection_rationale: Erratic demand regime (CV=0.220) with variable lead times suits continuous review (r,Q) policy. Normal approximation valid due to high non-zero fraction (98.5%).
research_insights.boundary_risk: Demand variability near erratic/variable boundary; monitor for regime shifts.
